requirements.title: Operation intent persisted before effects with monotonic fence
requirements.description: Operations are admitted durably with request-key idempotency and a fence; stale workers cannot commit or mutate the target.

validation.notes: AcquireWorker bumps the deployment fence; every fenced write (heartbeat, commit, unknown effect, active step, state) is refused with fence_stale for a superseded worker; concurrent acquirers admit exactly one; competing operations on one deployment serialise. Race-detected. Tagged [REQ:STC-P0-018].

Transition table (design D) refuses illegal moves; equal request replay returns one operation and one execution, different input conflicts (RUN-01/02); stale worker refused on commit and target mutation (RUN-04); failed recovery cannot report success (P07-A07); competing operations serialise through the owner (RUN-08).
Request-key idempotency scope (P03), reused by admission.

requirements.title: Owner restart reconciliation and lost-reply handling
requirements.description: Admitted and running operations are reconciled on startup using target receipts; unknown remote effects are recorded explicitly rather than inferred as failure or success.

validation.notes: Owner restart after admission and during each mutating step (faultinject worker_before_commit crash, fresh Service over the same database) resumes from receipts and reads the target receipt instead of replaying (RUN-03); lost reply reads the receipt before replaying (RUN-05); target unable to answer records an unknown effect and enters reconciling with one next action (RUN-06); unknown plan schema is an explicit incompatibility (RUN-10). Tagged [REQ:STC-P0-019].
Active-step marker and recorded unknown effects survive reacquisition and clear on commit.

requirements.title: Durable wait, cancellation and attach contract
requirements.description: Clients attach by operation ID after disconnect; cancellation stops at declared safe points; observer timeout never changes operation state.

validation.notes: Client disconnect keeps server-owned work attachable by operation id (P07-A01/RUN-07); cancellation stops at the declared safe boundary (P07-A06); observer timeout returns still_pending and never mutates; waiting_input is distinct from a dead worker. Tagged [REQ:STC-P0-020].
REST get/wait/cancel/list and SSE keyed by operation_id over the live router.
CLI exit-code contract (0 ok, 1 failed, 2 refused, 3 pending, 124 observer timeout) and shared standing rendering.
